newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks open higher on stable yen, US rally.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks open higher on stable yen, US rally.

text.p: Tokyo stocks opened higher on Monday as export-oriented shares were encouraged by a stable dollar trading well above 114.00 yen and bullish U.S. stocks.
Expectations of new inflows of money from domestic pension funds this week also supported the market, brokers said.
At 0013 GMT, the 225-share Nikkei average was up 135.82 points, or 0.66 percent, at 20,664.17. Its September futures stood 150 points higher at 20,740.
